description: Building intuitive user experiences with precision and care ❤

about.text: I’m a curious engineer who never stopped learning. Over the years I’ve worked across multiple stacks in both web and mobile and discovered that good software is always about empathy, no matter the technology. I love exploring new tools and frameworks and noticing how each one slightly changes the way I think about problems.

I’ve worked in a large product company and on small side projects, and I’ve learned to balance structure with creativity. I’m emotional in the sense that I genuinely care about user experience, yet methodical and realistic enough to understand risks early and manage expectations clearly.

I enjoy both the visible and invisible sides of engineering — from building clean interfaces to making the development process smoother for everyone, and especially diving into strange bugs that challenge how I see the system. Those moments of discovery are what keep the work exciting for me.
Beyond code, I train in pole sport, do cover dance, crochet, and study languages — I enjoy having hobbies that challenge different sides of me. I also maintain
for the genuine comfort of small daily puzzles and the feeling of steady progress.

experience.subtitle: iOS Developer · Kinopoisk
experience.description:
· Worked across multiple iOS and tvOS applications, combining modern and legacy codebases (SwiftUI, UIKit, Objective-C, widgets, extensions). 
· Acted as a feature lead of multiple UI features, taking responsibility for technical design, planning, and end-to-end delivery. 
· Led the migration to Tuist, resolved complex configuration issues, and contributed fixes back to the open-source project. 
· Built a security-sensitive local network authentication flow between the iOS app and multiple TV apps (Smart TV, Android TV), ensuring reliability and an extensible architecture for future use cases. 
· Improved the HLS downloads module by refactoring undocumented legacy code and fixing stability issues, while collaborating on the design of a new, more maintainable architecture.

experience.subtitle: Frontend Developer · Yandex Dzen

· Started as a junior developer and gradually took ownership of full feature lifecycles — from planning to release.

· Gained a strong ownership mindset and the ability to collaborate across multiple teams and technologies.
